name: megadj
description: Rate-limited YouTube Music library archiver with rekordbox-ready metadata — GetDat (acquire), FullTags (enrich), CrateDeck (USB drives)

scripts.lint: oxlint src fulltags cratedeck/src cratedeck/shared cratedeck/web cratedeck/test
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tools fulltags cratedeck/src cratedeck/shared cratedeck/web cratedeck/test
scripts.format: prettier --write src tools fulltags cratedeck/src cratedeck/shared cratedeck/web cratedeck/test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint
scripts.check:full: bun run check && bun test && bun run knip && bun run typecov
scripts.check:watch: bun run typecheck -- --watch & bun run lint --watch & wait
